title: Devlog #1 - De 2D a 3D | Creo mi juego con Opus 5.5
author: DetectiveExisting803

comments.author: DetectiveExisting803
comments.body:
Hi! This is my first devlog (video in Spanish). I'm learning gamedev from zero and building my game "Proyecto Vil" in Godot, with Claude (Opus 5.5) writing most of the code.



AI tools I'm using:

\- Claude for the code (combat, enemies, totems, the boss)

\- Meshy to turn my own 2D drawings into 3D models

\- Mixamo for animations



Happy to answer questions about the workflow. Feedback welcome!
